description: This file contains implementation code for retrieving system and GPU information, including memory stats and display size, interacting with system files and DRM (Direct Rendering Manager) interfaces.

methods.name: parseLine
methods.description: Parses a line of text to extract a numerical value, used for parsing memory info from system files.

methods.name: getMemInfo
methods.description: Reads /proc/meminfo to get specific memory parameter values.

methods.name: getPrimaryPlane
methods.description: Retrieves the primary display plane information via DRM.

methods.name: getGraphicSize
methods.description: Determines the width and height of the primary display by interfacing with DRM.

methods.name: SoC_GetTotalGpuRam
methods.description: Returns the total GPU memory in bytes.

methods.name: SoC_GetFreeGpuRam
methods.description: Returns the free GPU memory in bytes.

methods.name: SoC_GetGraphicsWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the display in pixels.

methods.name: SoC_GetGraphicsHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the display in pixels.
